text:
maria_sales: Hey team — LunaHealth sent over a 350-question SIG/CAIQ PDF and wants mapping to our controls + evidence. They've asked for an owner and ETA by EOD Fri. Uploaded to SF: https://sf.redwood.co/opps/LUNA-22 (attachment: luna_caiaq_v2.pdf)
alex_s: I can take the mapping if security OKs. Do they need full evidence (reports) or just control statements + config snippets?
jess_support: I already linked the CAIQ in the support case and dropped the basic answers we have in the KB. No evidence yet.
patrick_security: Assigned to security for intake. Quick notes: we need to validate any claims on encryption, KMS usage, network segmentation, and multi-tenancy isolation. For evidence, prefer screenshots of console + config snippets, or SOC2/ISO certs where applicable. I can review mappings but won't be able to compile evidence until Tue morning.
alex_s: Good to know. If we own the mapping (controls->our features), we can draft answers and tag Patrick for evidence gaps. ETA: initial draft by Thu EOD?
maria_sales: Customer asked about private deployment option for data-in-region. Also flagged pricing impact if we need dedicated capacity for LunaHealth. Can someone confirm who handles pricing uplift questions? cc @owen_eng
owen_eng: For pricing uplift / Dedicated vs Hosted we usually route to sales-ops. I can give a rough delta: dedicated pool + SSO/KMS support typically +30% commit. Will confirm exact numbers with Sales Ops tomorrow. If they need on-prem we'll need a lead time check.
patrick_security: For the CAIQ mapping I'll need the org id and any custom infra notes. Also call out: control CM-7 (key management) — if customer insists on HSM, we'll need a statement on supported KMS integrations and any limitations. @alex_s add a line for that.
alex_s: Noted. I'll add a section: "Key management & data residency" with details we support (AWS KMS, GCP KMS; HSM via partner) and a suggested caveat.
jess_support: FYI — customer mentioned they have an internal pentest coming up next month. Might speed up evidence request.
patrick_security: Ok assigning this to the security queue. Ticket: SEC-1148. I'll put a short intake checklist: 1) Confirm deployment model 2) Encrypted at rest proof 3) KMS config snippet or cert 4) Network diagram or tenancy statement 5) SOC2/ISO if available.
maria_sales: Thanks. Can we target a first-pass mapping to the customer by Fri EOD? If security can't make it, let's send partial answers and note outstanding evidence.
patrick_security: We can do a partial mapping by Fri but evidence will lag. I'll aim to provide a SOC2 statement + KMS guidance; screenshots later. If we need to escalate for dedicated capacity, ping @owen_eng and sales-ops.
deploy_bot: SEC-1148 created and added to security backlog (priority: P2)
alex_s: I'll start the control-to-feature mapping doc in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.co/pages/Luna-CAIQ-Mapping and drop draft here when ready. Please tag me for reviews.
maria_sales: Great — I'll let the customer know we have an owner and that a draft will arrive before EOD Fri. Thanks all :thumbsup:
